prep.work: W16A8 moments in H coordinates on C80 -> integer VQ0' fit for 614 Linears -> case-2000 init anchor -> untrained VQ0' held-out 40x2

train.work: beta on initial C80 -> 8 A+Z+K updates -> final anchor -> trained held-out 40x2 -> inference bundle export

format.coordinates: frozen Smooth0.5 scales and signs from the C80 calibration banks, then signed H128; no U
format.activation: per-token symmetric INT8 grid: scale=absmax/127, round half-to-even, clamp +-127, BF16 output; identity STE
format.weights: d4, two 256-entry integer codebooks, one BF16 scale per output row; each codebook pair sums inside [-127,127]; no B32 exponents
format.storage_compatibility: micro_codebook encoding with books stored as BF16 integers and all exponents 127, so the existing decoders run unchanged

fitting.moments: per-context mean square of A8 operands under original BF16 weights in H coordinates (W16A8), equal mean over the 80 C80 contexts
fitting.continuous_fit: weighted 2x256 additive k-means on row-RMS-normalized d4 vectors; metric = input second moment x row scale squared
fitting.integer_rule: delta=(max|C0|+max|C1|)/127 per layer, round both books to integers on delta (grow delta until bound sum <=127), reassign indices on the integer grid, row scale=row RMS x delta

training.loss: first10x6 motor MSE + lambda future NMSE + beta frozen-BF16-reader soft-bin KL
training.beta_rule: 0.1 x lambda x mean initial C80 future NMSE / mean initial C80 reader KL, frozen before update 1
training.schedule: same eight C80 batches as the loss-pair reader_kl arm
training.optimizer: Adam lr 5e-4, grad-norm clip 1, VQ moments cleared after update 1, fixed final8
training.trainable: 614 x (FP32 codebook master in integer-grid units / 250, log row scale)
training.ste: stored codebook = clamp(round(250 * master), +-bound); master gradient = 250 x integer-book gradient; row scale cast BF16
training.teachers: reuse cached C80 and held-out BF16 teachers; 0 new teacher queries
training.codebook_parameterization: masters in integer-grid units / 250; Adam lr 5e-4 moves an entry ~0.125 integer per update (~1 grid point over 8 updates, matching Q0 ~1 BF16 ulp); row scales unchanged (log, BF16 storage)

evaluation.aggregation: seed -> context -> suite -> equal four-suite mean

q0_reference.source: Q0 (R0 + MXVQ + A4) held-out overall from Q-Clip job 25937633.pbs101

export.anchor: results/arms/reader_kl/anchor.pt (case 2000, seed index 0, eager A8 action+future after update 8)
export.engine_notes: decode with existing micro decoder (exponents=127), skip U, A8 operand kernel; startup must match the anchor exactly
export.container: export_runtime.FORMAT with identity action/video rotations; 1b variant in bundle["variant"], use_u=False

scope: fixed-input held-out accuracy and inference bundle only; closed loop runs in the engine evaluator
